summary: Checkout -> payment reliability: what should we change?

description_versions.text: Umbrella ticket for intermittent checkout payment failures. Collect hypotheses and evidence; decide on one plan.
Umbrella ticket for intermittent checkout payment failures. UPDATE after incident: see incident review.

comments.author: Likhith Vardhan Goruputi
comments.body: Opening this to collect ideas. Over the last weeks we have seen short bursts of failed orders where checkout gets errors back from payment. Each burst lasted a few minutes and then cleared by itself. We do not have a clear reproduction. I would like one owner and one plan, but first let us list hypotheses here so we stop discussing it in five different chat threads.

comments.author: Likhith Vardhan Goruputi
comments.body: My bet is the client timeout. 2000ms is generous but when payment does the full risk review for large charges it can take most of a second, and with a bit of queueing we hit the timeout. I would raise DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS to 5000 in libs/httpclient and be done with it.

comments.author: Praneeth Kadem
comments.body: Raising the timeout just hides the problem and ties up checkout threads. The bursts line up with payment restarts, I think: when payment restarts, in-flight requests are cut. We should add proper connection draining to payment-svc instead.

comments.author: Praneeth Kadem
comments.body: I looked at the DB side. Velocity checks are fast with the customer index, so I do not think it is the database. That said, the payments table grows ~40k rows/day and we should keep an eye on insert latency. Not the cause today in my opinion.

comments.author: Likhith Vardhan Goruputi
comments.body: From the infra side: we are going to put a sidecar in front of payment-svc (OPS-12) for TLS and metrics. Once that is live, checkout should call the sidecar port 18112 instead of 18102. That would also give us connection-level metrics to settle this argument. I can prepare the checkout config change now so it is ready.

comments.author: Praneeth Kadem
comments.body: Please do not switch the port before OPS-12 is actually done; nothing listens on 18112 until the sidecar ships. The rollout is planned for next week.

comments.author: Likhith Vardhan Goruputi
comments.body: Alternative: retry 5xx and timeouts in the shared client. Retries would have hidden every burst we saw. I have a branch that retries up to 4 times.

comments.author: Praneeth Kadem
comments.body: Retrying timeouts against a slow dependency multiplies its load. I would rather not. If anything we should lower the pool acquire timeout further so payment fails fast.

comments.author: Likhith Vardhan Goruputi
comments.body: Summary so far, no agreement: (1) raise client timeout, (2) add draining to payment, (3) wait for the sidecar and move checkout to 18112, (4) retry more in the client, (5) tune the DB pool. I will ask each owner to add evidence, not opinions.
